name: Ord Grovner
description: Ord Grovner was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories near Courkrus. Originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot, the planet served as a staging area for the Imperial task force, led by Admiral Freeda, which wiped out the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates.
lead_paragraphs: Ord Grovner was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories near Courkrus. Originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot, the planet served as a staging area for the Imperial task force, led by Admiral Freeda, which wiped out the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates.
